observations: No production code calls the legacy handle's Watch, WatchAll, Keys, ListKeys or History any more (grep over packages/envoy/cmd and internal). bus.KeyValue documents the rule; it still embeds nats.KeyValue, so a future caller could reach the legacy methods by promotion. Nothing does today.
The spec-conforming observation from round 2 stands: once a recreated bucket's read completes, the list is the bucket as it stands, mid-fill included.

My mutation-during-reread driver no longer lands inside the read: the probe finds the recreate and the read completes before the 'recreated' line the driver keys on. In-read polls are covered by the rig's reread verdict instead.
